scenarios.title: Direct Simple cold-open requalifies after owner hydration

linkedTests.testTitle: BUG-004 SCN-B004-A: direct Simple cold-open requalifies after owner hydration without a mode change
TP-15-02 the production bridge reaches the SAME projection as the explicit runtime path for every module-backed wired tool (and the honest generic unavailable where the module is deliberately absent)

plannedRegressions.testTitle: BUG-004 SCN-B004-A: direct Simple cold-open requalifies after owner hydration without a mode change
plannedRegressions.command: npx --no-install playwright test --config=playwright.config.mjs --project=system-chrome tests/market-heatmap-control-surface.spec.mjs --grep "BUG-004 SCN-B004-A: direct Simple" --reporter=list
plannedRegressions.classification: e2e-ui real local page and same-origin static server with request and view-event observation only
plannedRegressions.discriminator: The test never leaves Simple. Production accepts the terminal owner snapshot, so a panel that remains unavailable is stale rather than honestly insufficient.

expectedAssertions: the initial Simple projection is honestly unavailable
terminal hydration reaches 135 priced constituents
the panel becomes ready automatically without a mode change
the adapter is simple-adapter/market-breadth/v1
the current shell view remains Simple

scenarios.title: Ready Simple applies all five production registry controls

linkedTests.testTitle: BUG-004 SCN-B004-B: ready Simple applies all five registry controls with owner parity and zero post-hydration requests
TP-15-03 market-heatmap Simple renders real steerable controls and actuating one recomputes the production projection with no refetch

plannedRegressions.testTitle: BUG-004 SCN-B004-B: ready Simple applies all five registry controls with owner parity and zero post-hydration requests
plannedRegressions.command: npx --no-install playwright test --config=playwright.config.mjs --project=system-chrome tests/market-heatmap-control-surface.spec.mjs --grep "BUG-004 SCN-B004-B: ready Simple" --reporter=list
plannedRegressions.classification: e2e-ui real local page and same-origin static server with request observation only
plannedRegressions.discriminator: The control set is registry-derived and every declared control must be actuated. Each rendered projection is compared with production runtime output over the same owner snapshot, so static relabeling or testing only window cannot pass.

expectedAssertions: window, grouping, size-metric, breadth-threshold, and outlier-sigma each expose their registry-declared accessible control
every declared control changes its model input and rendered production projection
each result equals production runtime output over the same owner snapshot
the request ledger remains empty after hydration
local commit 2f65a02a is preserved without a deployment claim

scenarios.title: Direct Power applies the existing native treemap controls

linkedTests.testTitle: BUG-004 SCN-B004-C: direct Power applies native treemap controls with zero post-hydration requests

plannedRegressions.testTitle: BUG-004 SCN-B004-C: direct Power applies native treemap controls with zero post-hydration requests
plannedRegressions.command: npx --no-install playwright test --config=playwright.config.mjs --project=system-chrome tests/market-heatmap-control-surface.spec.mjs --grep "BUG-004 SCN-B004-C: direct Power" --reporter=list
plannedRegressions.classification: e2e-ui real local page and same-origin static server with request observation only
plannedRegressions.discriminator: The page opens directly in Power. Every native group must expose exactly one aria-pressed=true button, move semantic selection after Enter, match :focus-visible with a computed non-transparent outline at least 2 CSS pixels wide, change owned output and treemap pixels, and retain an empty request ledger including grouping.

expectedAssertions: winSeg, sizeSeg, and grpSeg are visible in the existing Map panel
every group has exactly one aria-pressed=true button and aria-pressed=false on every alternative
each control is keyboard-operable and the focused target matches :focus-visible
computed focus outline style is not none, width is at least 2 CSS pixels, and color is not transparent
aria-pressed=true moves to the actuated value and clears from the former selection
each owned treemap or table interpretation visibly changes
grouping performs no fetch and the complete post-hydration request ledger remains empty

scenarios.title: Shared refresh and owner reuse are bounded and latest-result-wins

linkedTests.testTitle: TP-B004-01 requestSimpleRefresh rejects non-current contexts and settles invalidated queued work
linkedTests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern="^TP-B004-01 requestSimpleRefresh rejects non-current contexts and settles invalidated queued work$" tests/simple-production-bridge.unit.mjs

linkedTests.testTitle: TP-B004-02 requestSimpleRefresh coalesces same-turn duplicates and replaces the pending successor
linkedTests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern="^TP-B004-02 requestSimpleRefresh coalesces same-turn duplicates and replaces the pending successor$" tests/simple-production-bridge.unit.mjs

linkedTests.testTitle: TP-B004-03 accepted mid-run refresh immediately invalidates active generation and stale controls
linkedTests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern="^TP-B004-03 accepted mid-run refresh immediately invalidates active generation and stale controls$" tests/simple-production-bridge.unit.mjs

linkedTests.testTitle: TP-B004-04 current and stale refresh promises settle without overwriting current truth
linkedTests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern="^TP-B004-04 current and stale refresh promises settle without overwriting current truth$" tests/simple-production-bridge.unit.mjs

linkedTests.testTitle: TP-15-02 owner parity: every wired tool's Simple facts EQUAL the owner/Power-path values

expectedAssertions: only the exact current ordinary tool in current Simple reads its provider
rejected contexts and invalidated queued work resolve null with zero provider reads or panel writes
pre-start duplicates share one scheduled promise and one provider read
every accepted owner refresh claims a distinct newer generation before requestSimpleRefresh returns
one active run retains only the latest pending successor; a replaced successor resolves null
the active old generation becomes stale immediately and its rendered controls are disabled or behaviorally inert
stale control actuation performs no generation claim, runtime prepare, or panel mutation
stale active, ready, and unavailable completions resolve null and perform no panel mutation
current failure resolves an honest unavailable projection while the latest successor resolves its current projection
every rejected, cancelled, replaced, stale, current-failure, and latest-successor promise settles within the bounded HUNG guard
current controls remain ordered by runSequence
one boot union serves sector and constituent grouping
all Simple and Power levers reuse owner evidence and emit no acquisition request
the coordinator has no network, storage, cookie, beacon, publication, author, or focus-class authority
